description: Per-run judgment against recruiter-leads.md: what a sharp recruiter would have led with, and whether the report did (led, buried, missed, impossible, overclaim). Default per case; run-specific entries override.

h1_bad_resume.lead: Wrong role for the page; then five jobs in four years, two undated, gap since June 2023, filler, typos
h1_bad_resume.default: buried: the Verdict names the wrong role; CM1 is a line edit on the phone-sales bullet; undated roles CM2; the gap is not a Critical Miss; typos in next steps as 'compare with your original file'; filler, job-hopping, references never

runs.1: buried: Verdict names the wrong role; CM1 a line edit; the gap is CM2 but dated from November 2021, not June 2023; undated roles CM3; typos in next steps

h2_thin_resume.lead: For an internship nobody expects scale; show what the dashboard tracked
h2_thin_resume.default: impossible: no report shipped (validator refused both drafts); the refused draft's first fix was the dashboard line, which is the lead

h3_strong_resume.default: overclaim: 'One Critical Miss. Fix it first. It's the one most likely to cost you the interview.' over a roadmap-tradeoff ask on a resume the model itself scored 93 to 94

h4a_academic_cv_15_pages.lead: What job is this for? (and: nobody reads fifteen pages)
h4a_academic_cv_15_pages.default: impossible: refused before any call, 'Your resume text is very long. Try trimming extra content.' with no cap named

h4b_academic_cv_under_cap.lead: What job is this CV for?
h4b_academic_cv_under_cap.default: impossible: no report shipped (validator refused both drafts); the refused draft treats the CV as a fine faculty record (82 to 83) and never asks what job it is for

h4c_one_paragraph.lead: Put the line breaks back; the content underneath is decent
h4c_one_paragraph.default: missed: the formatting is never mentioned; CM1 asks for the work behind the on-time result

runs.1: led in the Verdict's second sentence ('The supplied text runs together'); CM1 asks for the work behind the on-time result
runs.2: impossible: no report shipped (validator refused both drafts); the refused draft did name the run-together text

h5_mismatched_posting.lead: You are not a nurse; this posting needs an RN license
h5_mismatched_posting.default: buried: the Verdict's second sentence names the mismatch; match score 5 and an honest fit sentence sit in Role fit; CM1 is a line edit on the analyst resume with the interview-cost lead; the first draft that said it plainly was refused

runs.1: buried: the Verdict is silent on the mismatch; match score 5 and the honest fit sentence sit in Role fit; CM1 a line edit; the missing-requirements list was stripped from 7 to 1; the first draft that said it plainly was refused
runs.3: buried: Verdict's third sentence names the mismatch; CM1 a line edit; the missing-requirements list was stripped from 7 to 0

h6_unverifiable_claim.lead: 'Led a team of 40' is the only number and nothing backs it; question it
h6_unverifiable_claim.default: missed: the Verdict praises the team of 40 as worth keeping near the top; CM1 is the 'Improved processes' line

b01_icu_nurse.lead: Ready; give charge and preceptor lines weight
b01_icu_nurse.default: overclaim: CM1 (charge-nurse responsibilities) is the right small ask, under a heading that says it could cost the interview

b02_teacher.lead: The reading-growth number is the line; move it up
b02_teacher.default: right line, wrong disposition: the reading-growth result is CM1 as a method ask, not the keep; class size is the keep

b03_welder.lead: Lead with the certs and the x-ray pass rate
b03_welder.default: buried: certifications never surface; CM1 asks what piping work a shutdown involved; keep is the 1/16-inch fit-up

runs.1: impossible: no report shipped (validator refused both drafts; first on a Skills section it says exists)

b04_retail_store_manager.lead: Send it; the summary's second turnaround has no backing
b04_retail_store_manager.default: led: CM1 is exactly the second-turnaround claim against the experience

b05_paralegal.lead: 250,000 pages and two trials are the lines
b05_paralegal.default: overclaim: keep names the production size (run 2) or the drafting range (run 1); CM1 asks which production tasks, under the interview-cost lead

b06_staff_accountant.lead: Every bullet is a duty; which accounts, how many, what the audit found
b06_staff_accountant.default: led: CM1 and CM2 ask for the close tasks, the audit materials and the number of accounts

b07_account_executive.lead: 108% of quota and $1.1M first; cut the server job
b07_account_executive.default: led via the Verdict and keep (quota and ARR); CM1 (what you handled in demos) is low stakes under the interview-cost lead; server job never mentioned

b08_warehouse_supervisor.lead: 35 associates is the scale; add what the shift hit
b08_warehouse_supervisor.default: buried: asks for a scheduling example, never for the shift's orders, accuracy or safety record

b09_executive_assistant_freelance.lead: June 2023 to February 2025 has nothing on it
b09_executive_assistant_freelance.default: missed: the twenty-month gap is never mentioned in either run; the freelance line counts as current

b10_it_support_recent_grad.lead: For a first job this is fine; A+ and the internship up top
b10_it_support_recent_grad.default: led beyond the blind lead: CM2 is the eighteen-month gap since May 2025 (the blind lead missed it); CM3 asks an intern for ticket counts

b11_recent_grad_bad.lead: The headline says manager; you were an intern
b11_recent_grad_bad.default: led: CM1 is the headline claim; the gap since May 2024 is CM2

b12_coo_executive_two_page.default: overclaim: CM1 asks what topics the board heard, on a resume the model scored 94

runs.1: impossible: no report shipped (validator refused both drafts on ordinary words: 'Growing Lakeshore', 'both, help, coo, involve, more')

b13_marketing_vp_elite.lead: Ready; strip the 'I' from every bullet
b13_marketing_vp_elite.default: overclaim: CM1 is the launch-process definition; the 'I' bullets are never mentioned

b14_teacher_to_instructional_designer.lead: The page says teacher; you want instructional design
b14_teacher_to_instructional_designer.default: missed: no fix names the target role or moves the design work up; CM1 asks for a learning activity in the Canvas module

b15_career_changer_maria.lead: Lead with the data projects; cut 'proven track record'; name the role
b15_career_changer_maria.default: buried: the Verdict does say the transition is clear; the filler summary is never mentioned; CM1 asks for a capstone finding

runs.1: impossible: no report shipped (validator refused 'two data projects' and 'Move DATA PROJECTS' in the positioning sentence)

b16_career_changer_bad.lead: What job is this for? The freelance role has no dates
b16_career_changer_bad.default: buried: the headline naming the role is CM2 or CM3; the undated freelance role is CM3 in run 1 only; CM1 is a shift-supervision line edit

b17_hr_generalist_career_break.lead: The break is dated, good; now results, and say you're back
b17_hr_generalist_career_break.default: led on the line (employee relations); the sixteen months after the break ended surface only as an integrity-pass sentence in run 1, never as a Critical Miss

b18_military_to_civilian.lead: Translate the military terms; the $14M and 18% to 6% lines are excellent
b18_military_to_civilian.default: led in the Verdict ('some military terms need translation', run 1) and the keep ($14M, zero losses); CM1 asks what supplies a field exercise involved

b19_non_native_english.lead: The grammar will cost you; the Vietnam role is strongest and last
b19_non_native_english.default: missed: grammar is never mentioned; the sequence is described, not questioned; keep is the 400 invoices

b20_customer_success_manager.lead: 48 accounts is the size; what happened to renewals?
b20_customer_success_manager.default: led: CM1 asks for the renewal result on the at-risk bullet

b21_customer_success_manager_with_postin.lead: The posting wants retention numbers you don't show
b21_customer_success_manager_with_postin.default: led: CM1 asks for verified retention results; the fit sentence in Role fit is honest (65); the missing list was stripped to []; identical CM and score to the no-posting run

runs.1: impossible: no report shipped (validator refused 'Looker', a word from the posting, in job_alignment.missing)

b22_office_manager_paragraphs.default: missed: the format is never mentioned; CM1 is a line detail, a different line each run

b23_pharmacy_tech_table.lead: The table will scramble; rewrite as lines
b23_pharmacy_tech_table.default: led in the Verdict ('The separate duties table makes readers jump back')

runs.2: led as CM1: 'Move each entry in Duties and Results beneath its matching job' (a structural fix)

b24_physical_therapist_strong.default: overclaim: a method ask on a result line under the interview-cost lead

b25_fpa_analyst_strong.default: overclaim: a method ask on the $240M budget line under the interview-cost lead

b26_construction_pm_strong.default: overclaim: a method ask under the interview-cost lead

b27_backend_engineer_senior.default: overclaim: a detail ask under the interview-cost lead on a 89 to 91

b28_cybersecurity_analyst.default: overclaim: a scenario ask under the interview-cost lead

b29_mechanical_engineer.lead: The Arlo line needs what shipped
b29_mechanical_engineer.default: led: CM1 is the Arlo line; CM2 (severity) asks for a measurable design result

b30_social_worker.lead: How many families on the caseload?
b30_social_worker.default: led: CM1 is the caseload count

runs.1: buried: the caseload count is CM2, promoted by the severity check; CM1 is the home-visit assessment line

b31_kitchen_manager.lead: 180 seats is the size; food cost, labor, inspections, staff count
b31_kitchen_manager.default: buried: asks for inspection checks or schedule constraints, never food cost or labor; 180 seats is noted in the Verdict

b32_logistics_dispatcher.lead: How many drivers, loads a day, on-time rate
b32_logistics_dispatcher.default: buried: the driver or load count is CM2; CM1 asks for a driver-issue example

b33_nonprofit_program_manager.lead: How many students placed, how many employers, grants worth what
b33_nonprofit_program_manager.default: led: CM1 asks how many students the program serves (run 1) or what happened to them (run 2)

b34_bank_branch_manager_gap.lead: Nothing since December 2024; one dated line
b34_bank_branch_manager_gap.default: buried: the gap is CM2 in both runs behind a method ask on the deposit-growth line

b35_marketing_coordinator_gap.lead: Nothing since March 2024; one dated line
b35_marketing_coordinator_gap.default: buried: the gap is CM2 in both runs behind a reporting-measures ask; the band flipped between runs (67 vs 80)

b36_product_designer_unrelated.lead: Barista now; design ended February 2024; lead with design
b36_product_designer_unrelated.default: led in the Verdict (run 1: 'Your current cafe role appears before your design work'); recent design work is CM2 behind a booking-flow line edit

b37_marketing_director_bad.lead: Director over Instagram posts for a candle shop; the title reads inflated
b37_marketing_director_bad.default: led in the Verdict ('The director title stands out, but the bullets don't yet explain...'); the gap since January 2025 is CM2; no title Critical Miss; band 'Mostly clear' at 80

runs.1: led in the Verdict; title mismatch is CM3, the gap CM2, an Instagram line edit CM1; band 'Mostly clear' at 80

b38_layoff_gap_james.lead: 'Results-driven' is filler; the 35% MQL line is the story; the freelance line is thin
b38_layoff_gap_james.default: led on the thin freelance line (CM1 and CM2); the filler summary is never mentioned; keep is the $40M ARR context, not the 35% line

b39_new_grad_daniel.lead: Cut the objective and soft skills; name a feature in the internship
b39_new_grad_daniel.default: led on the feature (CM1); the objective and soft-skills line are never mentioned; CM2 asks an intern for team size or users served

b40_senior_ic_wei.lead: Ready; the break-rate line needs its number
b40_senior_ic_wei.default: overclaim: CM1 asks for a ledger-redesign tradeoff; the break-rate number is fix 3; the calibrator pulled the model's 85 to 78, 'Mostly clear'
